{{Quote|What the Rear Admiral says is true&mdash;the Alliance ''is'' slowly bleeding to death.|Bail Antilles|<ref name="Legacy 20" />}}
'''Bail Antilles''', a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was a [[Politics/Legends|politician]] who rose through the ranks of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]] and became one of the three members of the government's ruling [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]] at some point before [[130 ABY]]. He was known to be a level-headed individual who carefully considered his options, and he often provided the swing vote between his fellow Triumvirs, [[Gial Gahan]] and [[Nu Toreena]]. Based on the Alliance [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Antilles had a daughter named [[Ona Antilles|Ona]].

Antilles served in the Triumvirate during the Alliance's [[Sith–Imperial War]] with the [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]], which saw numerous Alliance member worlds defect to the enemy. When [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admiral]] [[Piers Petan]] proposed striking at a lightly-guarded [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] at the planet [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]], Antilles's vote was the deciding factor. Although [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kol Skywalker]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] both suspected a trap, Antilles felt that the dying Alliance needed to take the risk. The Empire sprang their trap at the [[Battle of Caamas]], and the outmatched Alliance surrendered and conceded the war. The Triumvirs were replaced by loyal Imperial bureaucrats, and Antilles [[Death/Legends|died]] at some point before [[137 ABY]].

==Biography==
===Prelude to war===
{{Quote|Of the Triumvirate, Gial Gahan supported the Jedi&mdash;as usual&mdash;while Nu Toreena was already in Petan's camp. She always went for the quick fix. Bail Antilles was the only undecided player.|Gar Stazi, recalling the politics of the Triumvirate|<ref name="Legacy 20" />}}
[[File:Deference.jpg|thumb|left|125px|Bail Antilles was level-headed and considered all options.]]
Bail Antilles was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="LECG" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Legacy 42" /> who came from a [[Antilles family (Galactic Alliance)|family]] that was dedicated to governmental service.<ref name="LECG" /> Prior to [[130 ABY]],<ref name="Legacy 20" /> he became a [[Politics/Legends|politician]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], a constitutional federation of member [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and allied autonomous states.<ref name="LECG" /> At some point, he [[Reproduction/Legends|sired]] a daughter, [[Ona Antilles]].<ref name="Legacy 42" /> Antilles's personal charisma, connections, and family name allowed him to rise through the political ranks, and he eventually became a member of the Galactic Alliance's ruling [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]].<ref name="LECG" /> On the Alliance's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Antilles served alongside the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gial Gahan]] and the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Nu Toreena]],<ref name="Legacy 20" /> all three of them having been elected by the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]]. Each Triumvir worked individually with specific government offices and [[Advisor/Legends|advisory]] councils,<ref name="LECG" /> and the three often consulted with members of the Alliance-allied [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="Legacy 42" /><ref name="Legacy 20" /> A majority was required before the Triumvirate could make decisions or set policies, and the level-headed Antilles often cast the deciding vote.<ref name="LECG" />

The Triumvirate faced a crisis in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[127 ABY]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had been working with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]&mdash;a [[Species/Legends|species]] hated and feared by the [[galactic community]] due to a [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war of conquest]] they had initiated a [[Time/Legends|century]] prior&mdash;to restore ravaged worlds with Yuuzhan Vong [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] [[Biot|technology]] in an effort called the [[Ossus Project]]. The project was secretly [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] by the mysterious [[One Sith]], however, and [[Death/Legends|lethal]] [[Mutant|mutations]] began to occur in the terraformed worlds' populations. [[The galaxy/Legends|The galaxy]] was outraged,<ref name="LECG" /> but the Jedi convinced the Galactic Alliance to stand behind the Yuuzhan Vong. When the [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]] called for retribution and declared war on the Alliance,<ref name="Legacy 0 Coruscant">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]] {{C|under "Coruscant"}}</ref> Antilles, Gahan, and Toreena found themselves leading their government through the [[Sith–Imperial War]].<ref name="LECG" />

===Alliance's end===
{{Quote|Whatever our misgivings, we must chance the opportunity we've been given. Combined fleets under Rear Admiral Petan will make the strike at Caamas.|Bail Antilles casts a decisive vote|<ref name="Legacy 20" />}}
As the Empire exploited the failure of the Ossus Project to draw new worlds into its influence, the Alliance lost [[Star system/Legends|system]] after system, as well as vital military support. Many of the war plans concocted by Antilles and the Triumvirate failed,<ref name="LECG" /> but the Empire struggled against the [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]] of the Jedi.<ref name="Legacy 15">[[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref> However, [[128 ABY|one year]] into the conflict,<ref name="Legacy 8">[[Legacy (2006) 8|''Legacy'' (2006) 8]]</ref> the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] emerged from hiding and entered the fighting on the Empire's side.<ref name="LECG" /> The Empire won victory after victory over the next two years,<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and by 130 ABY, factions within the Alliance who felt that their organization was grievously suffering sought a quick end to the war. When the Human [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admiral]] [[Piers Petan]] received intelligence that [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] and a light escort would be covertly meeting with representatives of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] and [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] near the planet [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]], he came before the Triumvirate on Coruscant with a plan: send all available [[Starship/Legends|ships]] to Caamas, capture or kill Fel, and force a peace upon the Empire.<ref name="Legacy 20" />

[[File:Preludetodisaster.jpg|thumb|right|350px|The Triumvirate plans a fateful strike at Caamas.]]
Also present at the meeting were Human [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kol Skywalker]] and [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]], both of whom expressed a belief that the intelligence had been planted in order to lure the Galactic Alliance [[Core Fleet]] away from Coruscant and into a trap. Gahan stood by the Jedi and cast his vote against the action while Toreena supported Petan, which left the decision to Antilles. He reluctantly obliged, believing that they had to take the risk despite their misgivings. The [[Battle of Caamas]] was indeed a trap, and the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Alliance fleet]] was [[Space warfare/Legends|defeated]] while the Sith simultaneously [[Battle of Coruscant (Sith–Imperial War)|attacked]] the Jedi present on a defenseless Coruscant. Petan surrendered to Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Morlish Veed]], which brought the war to an end.<ref name="Legacy 20" /> The Empire took control of every Alliance member world, and the Galactic Alliance ceased to exist.<ref name="LECG" />

The Empire preserved the Alliance [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]], adapting the existing political and governmental services for its new regime; although the Triumvirate was retained, Antilles and his comrades were quickly replaced with loyal Imperial bureaucrats. The Triumvirate became an executive body at the command of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]],<ref name="LECG" /> who was soon afterward [[Attack on Emperor Fel|usurped]] from his throne by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]] and sent into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]].<ref name="Legacy 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Krayt's [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] was [[Second Imperial Civil War|challenged]] by Admiral Stazi, who had escaped from Caamas and formed the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]],<ref name="Legacy 20" /><ref name="Legacy 21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref> and Ona Antilles served Stazi as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. Bail Antilles died at some point prior to [[137 ABY]], by which time Ona no longer thought of him.<ref name="Legacy 42" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Admiral Stazi, what do ''you'' think?|Antilles seeks Gar Stazi's advice|<ref name="Legacy 20" />}}
Bail Antilles was able to rise through the Galactic Alliance's political ranks due to his family name, connections, and personal charisma. As a member of the Triumvirate, he was known to carefully consider all options and not unwaveringly follow any particular organization or policy. Antilles was seen as level-headed, and he often provided the swing vote between<ref name="LECG" /> the Jedi-sympathetic Gial Gahan and the quick&ndash;fix&ndash;seeking Nu Toreena. When deciding whether or not to attack the Empire at Caamas, Antilles considered the opposing viewpoints of both Piers Petan and Gar Stazi before ultimately choosing to risk the attack&mdash;Antilles felt that the Alliance, bereft of support from a number of systems, was slowly [[Blood/Legends|bleeding]] to death.<ref name="Legacy 20" />

Antilles's [[Hair/Legends|hair]] was [[Color/Legends|brown]], his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were blue, and his skin was light in color.<ref name="Legacy 20" /> He could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], [[Durese/Legends|Durese]], [[High Galactic (language)|High Galactic]], [[Mon Calamari (language)|Mon Calamarian]], and [[Sullustese/Legends|Sullustese]], and he possessed fine [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], an encrypted [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bail Antilles was introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]], authors of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''. He first appeared in a flashback in the series' [[Legacy (2006) 20|twentieth issue]], which was penciled by [[Omar Francia]] and released in [[February]] [[2008]].<ref name="Legacy 20" /> Further information on the character was provided in [[2009]]'s ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', written by [[Rodney Thompson]], [[Sterling Hershey]], and [[Gary Astleford]].<ref name="LECG" />

The name "Bail Antilles" has a long history in both ''Star Wars'' [[Canon]] and Legends, having first appeared in [[George Lucas]]'s 132-page [[The Star Wars rough draft|rough draft]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|the original ''Star Wars'' film]], completed in [[May]] [[1974]].<ref name="Rough Draft">{{WebCite|url=http://starwarz.com/starkiller/2010/03/the-star-wars-rough-draft|text=The Star Wars&mdash;Rough Draft|author=Wahlberg, Bjorn|date=2010-03-31|work=Starkiller, the Jedi Bendu Script Site|archivedate=20110716133624}}</ref> That character was eventually renamed [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], and a different [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]] was later mentioned in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="Bail Organa Databank">{{DB|character|bailorgana|Organa, Bail}}</ref> ''[[Murder on the Executor]]'', a 2009 [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying adventure]], additionally used "[[Bail Antilles (Rebel Alliance)|Bail Antilles]]" as an alias for an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Murder on the Executor">"[[Murder on the Executor|Murder on the ''Executor'']]"</ref> [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] of [[Lucasfilm]] has established that "Antilles" is a very common name in the ''Star Wars'' universe, analogous to the family names "Jones" and "Smith" in some English-speaking countries.<ref name="Antilles Smith">{{WebCite|url=http://www.galacticempire.net/swfaq.php#2a|text=GEN Star Wars FAQ|author=Sansweet, Stephen J.|partialdate=2007-12|work=Galactic Empire Network|archivedate=20100706065240}}</ref>
